meta.title: Filter-binding control and baseline sensitivity audit
meta.subset_rule: All 91 sublibraries; drilldown includes WT and all 60 single substitutions at protospacer positions -20 through -1. All other targets are summarized, not in the drilldown.
meta.normalization: 1 - target_count / (sum(target_zero)/sum(control_zero)*control_count + 0.1); metadata-listed zero-time points pooled (3, except S32 has 2); control=CM+KO
meta.threshold_note: Exploratory triage settings, not the authors' published QC and not a pass/fail assay acceptance criterion.
